I answered Hollis in his #central-team thread: the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47. Pree posted Dock 23 in that channel on 14 Oct, then corrected it the same morning to Gate 47 because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing posted there since changes that, so Gate 47 is the one for his account sheet.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so everything I used came from a channel he can read himself.
